source_issues.title: KNN无训练、唯一超参数与现代检索的概括
source_issues.note: K不是唯一配置：距离、权重、缩放和索引等也影响模型。保存数据、预处理/索引构建可能有成本，fit直接存引用才可视局部O(1)。RAG/向量库不总只是相同精确KNN算法；SVM预测可依支持向量数，不统一O(d)。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent limited source/mathematical reading; no source correction or broader external research.
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload preserved, not silently repaired in translation.

source_issues.title: K取值、平票和训练误差边界
source_issues.note: K=1零训练误差需无冲突重复点和相应自身匹配规则；奇数K只避免无权重二类票数平票。K=N多数类指无权分类，未必最大偏差。距离加权敏感性、K=sqrt(N)为条件性启发式，非普适保证。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent limited source/mathematical reading; no source correction or broader external research.
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload preserved, not silently repaired in translation.

source_issues.title: 度量定义、零向量和p定义域
source_issues.note: 余弦距离为1-cos而非角度本身，且非一般度量；零向量公式未定义，代码人为返回1。Minkowski为度量需p>=1；L1较L2稳健、模长都是噪声及始终标准化依数据语境。
source_issues.verification_scope: 完整读b0139后有限执行：单位向量0/60/120度余弦距离1.5>0.5+0.5；p=.5二维对角距离4>两边和2；零向量约定返回1。
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload preserved, not silently repaired in translation.

source_issues.title: 高维距离集中和维数门槛缺前提
source_issues.note: 距离最大/最小比趋1依分布、样本数、独立性、内在维数和距离定义；100维1.01/1000维1.001不是普适数值。20-50阈值不是理论界；树索引加速本身不会改善无信息距离的统计问题。
source_issues.verification_scope: Independent limited source/mathematical reading; no source correction or broader external research.
source_issues.treatment: Source wording/payload preserved, not silently repaired in translation.
